definition: What a product is to this organisation, deciding whether it may be bought, made, used or sold. A product may be more than one kind at once.

values.name: Raw material
values.definition: An ingredient or substance that enters a formulation.

values.name: Packaging component
values.definition: A container, closure, label, case or divider.

values.name: Indirect material
values.definition: Used in production without entering the product.

values.name: Part-made good
values.definition: Made and used internally; neither bought nor sold.

values.name: Consumer unit
values.definition: The unit a consumer buys.

values.name: Case

values.name: Pallet

values.name: Family
values.definition: Not a physical thing: the group a set of variants belongs to.
